markdown:
CrowdFarming
is a direct-to-consumer European farm-to-table platform headquartered in Madrid, Spain, founded in 2017 by brothers and farmers
Gabriel and Gonzalo Úrculo
, alongside co-founders
Juliette Simonin
and
Moises Duch
. It is an independent private company backed by venture investors like Astanor and Cipio Partners
, and does not function as a subsidiary of a larger parent corporation.
